variables.{{keywords}}: Up to six visual keywords extracted from the narration beat.

photographic.label: Photographic
photographic.sceneTemplate: A cinematic editorial photograph depicting {{keywords}}. Show one immediately recognizable subject and one supporting element that makes the action clear. Keep the full subject visible near the center, occupying about sixty percent of the frame height. Use separated foreground, subject, and background planes, generous margins, and an uncluttered lower third.
photographic.stylePrompt: Cinematic editorial photograph. Charcoal-black environment, warm off-white subject highlights, acid-lime focal accent. Strong silhouette, cinematic depth, crisp material detail, one dominant subject, uncluttered background. Separate foreground, subject, and background planes for parallax. Wide empty margins and a calm, uncluttered lower third.
photographic.negativePrompt: illustration, anime, cartoon, vector art, lineart, flat graphic, 3d render, plastic surface, busy background, collage, multiple competing subjects
